units.keyOffsets: NADEL Quetzal (CHRK) / Peregrine (CHRK) / Puffin (CHRK) / Osprey (SKNR) / Cotinga (SKNR?)
units.comments: Cherokee looks strong and given the depth and proximity to Quetzel etc.. should be very good. The Skinner section looks productive - would anticipate this to be very beneficial to the Cherokee or as a standalone target. The Red Fork also looks very good - thicker than 19N19W good - thicker package of net sand and likely higher GOR but it is present..and productive.. Cleveland also appears productive - has been tested and made gas.. NOTE: section is faulted in the southern most end of the 3 Mi unit.. Would drill from N to S along well control until fault encountered - steering line here would be very helpful - Given well control, this might be my FIRST unit to drill
units.drillingCommentary: Drill from N-S due to fault on southern end.. Steering line would greatly benefit this unit and adjacent unit
